method: Exported production createSpaceController factory with actual DOM callbacks and the real flight, commerce, courier, survey and save-validation engine. Only the asynchronous renderer boundary and browser DOM are adapters. Tests ordinary animation-time completion, once-per-frame physics, retained inertia, multi-pointer controls, continuous scan, genuine station actions, camera requests, fullscreen targeting, delayed readiness, WebGL failure/retry and context loss. Actual WebGL visuals, browser CSS and hardware touch are separate browser acceptance.
